Namsan Park Namsan Beacon Fire Station

a 봉수대 signal station. fire and smoke telegraph system. this one had a five fire code used to warn of war state. There used to be five of these at the site but only this one was rebuilt in 1993. they used to conect to a network of 673 others.
poster filmed in daum and traced in city records. and a site visit some time ago, plus other websites of visitors etc.
